description:
We are seeking a dedicated Quality Control & Quality Assurance Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in ensuring our products and services meet the highest standards of quality and compliance. As a Quality Control & Quality Assurance Engineer, you will be at the forefront of maintaining the integrity of our processes and deliverables, playing a crucial part in our commitment to excellence. Your expertise, particularly with a background in facilities management (FM) or operations maintenance, will significantly enhance our quality assurance efforts and contribute to our clients' satisfaction and trust.

In this position, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and advance your career in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, where team members are encouraged to share ideas and innovate. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, gaining insights into various aspects of our operations while contributing to the overall success of the organization. This role is ideal for those who are passionate about quality assurance and are eager to make a difference in the accounting sector.

Moreover, as you progress in your career with us, you will have access to training programs and mentorship opportunities designed to enhance your professional growth. Our commitment to employee development ensures that you will always be equipped with the latest knowledge and skills needed to excel in your role. Join us in our mission to uphold the highest standards of quality, and be a part of a team that values your contributions and supports your aspirations.

Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement quality control processes and procedures to ensure compliance with industry standards, utilizing tools like statistical process control (SPC) to monitor performance and identify areas for improvement.
• Conduct regular inspections and audits of products and services, documenting findings and collaborating with teams to address any discrepancies and enhance overall quality.
• Design and execute testing protocols for new products, ensuring they meet quality specifications and regulatory requirements before launch, thereby minimizing risks and enhancing customer satisfaction.
• Work closely with product development teams to provide quality assurance support throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that quality considerations are integrated into the design and manufacturing processes.
• Analyze quality data and trends to identify root causes of defects and inefficiencies, using tools such as Six Sigma methodologies to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
• Prepare detailed quality reports for management, summarizing findings, recommendations, and action plans, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic planning.
• Facilitate training sessions for team members on quality standards and best practices, fostering a culture of quality awareness and accountability across the organization.
• Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure that materials and components meet quality specifications, establishing strong relationships to enhance supply chain reliability.
• Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in quality assurance practices, recommending new tools and technologies to improve our quality management systems.

Skills
• Proficient in quality management systems and methodologies, including ISO standards and Six Sigma principles.
• Strong analytical skills to interpret complex data and derive actionable insights for quality improvement.
• Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
• Experience with statistical analysis tools and software for quality control processes.
• Ability to develop and implement comprehensive testing protocols for product validation.
• Detail-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to maintaining high-quality standards.
• Background in facilities management or operations maintenance, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of operational processes and quality assurance needs.

Responsibilities


• Lead a team in testing new and customized ATS applications as per client requirements.

• Coordinate with the team to conduct in-depth testing for modified and new systems.

• Ensure the Testing Team provides support to Implementers as requested by the PMO Director or Implementers.

• Supervise team members and assist the Education Sector Head in performance appraisals.

• Define time-specific goals and Key Result Areas (KRAs) for team members.

• Motivate and guide team members to achieve team objectives and identify areas for improvement.

• Support HR in hiring and training new recruits.

• Address team queries, resolve issues, and ensure effective communication of organizational strategies.

• Monitor team performance metrics and implement corrective actions when necessary.

• Collaborate with project managers, product managers, and developers to ensure alignment with project and testing objectives.

• Review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide feedback.

• Analyze functional specifications and create detailed test plans and test cases.

• Implement testing processes for new and existing ATS products to meet client needs.

• Assess applications for usability, functionality, and potential flaws in technology, design, or implementation.

• Monitor the debugging process and ensure effective defect resolution.



Qualifications


• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (Mandatory).

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Preferred).

• At least 3 years of experience in software development and QA methodologies.

• Strong experience with QA tools, test strategies, and automation testing.

• Oracle Certified Associate (OCA).

• ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level – Test Analyst.

• QA Tools: Quality Center, ClearQuest, Requisite Pro, Test Director, JIRA, Selenium, QTP.

• Programming Languages: Java, SQL/PLSQL.

• Databases: Oracle 11g/12c.
